scope: Where the expert formal model (formal/) departs from the source documents. Only the formal model and the documents are compared; results/, claims/ and flow/ are not part of this file. Entries marked material=false were found in passing; the minor list is not exhaustive.

categories.contradiction: The formal model does something the documents rule out.
categories.convention: The formal model fixes a choice the documents leave open or do not state.
categories.scope: The formal model contains content that is not in the documents.

doc_check.confirmed: The quoted text was checked in the document, or the document was searched and is silent on the point.
doc_check.pending: Not yet confirmed against the whole document set.

document.quote: the existence of mechanisms (certification authority, manual

entries.description: Every signing key is generated by honest processes and handed out on the private channel s, so the attacker never owns a credential, and each session is pre-paired with an honest peer whose public key is known up front (the responder does not look up the initiator's key from ID_U). The document only assumes some mechanism binds identities to keys; it says nothing that excludes an attacker holding a valid credential.

entries.description: The identifiers ID_U and ID_V are private constructors of the public key, so the attacker cannot compute them even from the public key. The document says an identifier contains or uniquely identifies the credential (e.g. x5t), i.e. it is public or derivable.
